question: In Google Calendar: Change the time zone to America/New_York on the Ops Rotation calendar I own whose description mentions weekend on-call coverage. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I checked all four Ops Rotation calendars you own (APAC, EMEA, LATAM) — none of them mention weekend on-call coverage in their **description**.

Closest match: **Ops Rotation – EMEA** has that phrasing ("Weekend on-call coverage rota posted here every Friday"), but it's in the calendar's *location* field, not the description. Its description is "Coordinates staffing schedules for the EMEA operations team."

So per your instruction, I'm not changing anything. If you'd like, I can set the EMEA calendar's time zone to America/New_York — just say the word.
